responsibility: Defines the crate’s reusable diagnostic types for `rustc_middle` analyses and query results. It packages structured errors, notes, labels, and helper subdiagnostics for middle-layer responsibilities such as drop checking, opaque type mismatches, layout computation, recursion and type-length limits, ABI adjustment failures, and related semantic errors so other parts of the compiler can emit consistent diagnostics through the diagnostics framework.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `mir/interpret/error.rs`, which defines execution-time interpreter/const-eval failures and guarded result types, and `ty/error.rs`, which turns type mismatches into printable descriptions, this `error.rs` is the crate-wide home for reusable structured diagnostics emitted by middle-layer analyses and queries.
